purpose: Freeze expectation/valuation context before forward selections. These sources are validation/expectation inputs only, never discovery inputs.

cases.name: 徐工机械

valuationExamples.source: 太平洋证券/同花顺摘要

cases.rationale: Consensus already expects profit growth, but valuation is modest relative to the forward earnings path and price has materially lagged over 120d.

cases.name: 中恒电气
cases.rationale: Recent de-rating does not remove the very high embedded growth burden; the current hub event is mainly a magnitude/duration update rather than a fresh company-specific order reset.

cases.name: 科华数据
cases.rationale: Valuation burden is lower than the purest AIDC expressions, but the current pack has weaker incremental AIDC order evidence and 2026 profit includes non-operating support in some forecasts.

cases.name: 南方航空
cases.rationale: 20d/60d relative performance is near benchmark and 120d is weak; the issue is not crowding but whether oil/RMB relief is large and persistent enough to overcome the H1 loss base.

cases.name: 格林美
cases.rationale: Price is not highly absorbed, but the September hub event is chiefly an industry-structure diagnostic and does not yet create a new absolute earnings catalyst.
